description: Market data for Credit Derivatives trades #28-30 (5Y ORCL CDS buy-protection, 5Y META CDS buy-protection, 5Y CDX.NA.IG sell-protection). See docs/design/AITrade_quantlib_portfolio_marketdata.md §1.6, §2.6, §3.2 (Credit/CDS), §4.7.

portfolio.instrument: 5Y ORCL CDS — buy protection (issuer hedge for bond #17)
5Y META CDS — buy protection (issuer hedge for bond #18)

portfolio.ql_engine: CreditDefaultSwap vs index-implied flat hazard curve
portfolio.notes: QL does not natively price CDX tranches; the unfunded index is modeled as a single CreditDefaultSwap against an index-implied flat hazard curve bootstrapped from the DTCC index spread.

notes: DTCC public price dissemination starts 2023-12-29; dtcc_start_date sets a clean 2024-01-01 start.

keep_from_date (per source) is the oldest record kept. It must be <= every pinned valuation date (golden_pvs.json valuation_date, the real-data tests' VDATE) minus the pricer's curve_lookback_days (365), else those dates price from fewer prints; tests/pricer/test_credit.py checks this and the adapters warn at runtime. Move it forward when the pinned dates move (e.g. at a book roll), then re-ingest.

Single-name and index CDS spreads are transaction-driven: aggregate the week's NEWT/MODI/CORR prints per reference entity + Expiration Date (tenor bucket) and take the notional-weighted median for the QL hazard-curve bootstrap.

dtcc_single_name.name: DTCC/SEC SDR CREDITS — Single-Name CDS (ORCL, META)
dtcc_single_name.description: US single-name CDS are security-based swaps under SEC jurisdiction — use the sec/eod/ S3 path, NOT cftc/eod/ (the CFTC CREDITS path carries only index CDS with an empty Underlying Asset Name). 'Underlying Asset Name' is populated here. Running spread is in 'Spread-Leg 1' (decimal fraction, e.g. 0.01535 = 153.5 bp); 'Fixed rate-Leg 1' = 0.01 confirms the 100 bp IG standard coupon. Primary input to the QL PiecewiseDefaultCurve<HazardRate,BackwardFlat> hazard bootstrap + IsdaCdsEngine for trades #28-29.

dtcc_index.name: DTCC/CFTC SDR CREDITS — Index CDS (CDX.NA.IG / CDX.NA.HY)
dtcc_index.description: CDX/iTraxx index CDS are swaps under CFTC jurisdiction — use the cftc/eod/ S3 path. 'Underlying Asset Name' is empty for index trades; filter on 'UPI Underlier Name' which holds the index name exactly (e.g. 'CDX.NA.IG'). Running spread in 'Spread-Leg 1' (decimal). The on-the-run 5Y point is the deepest Expiration Date bucket (e.g. 2031-06-20 for the June-2026 / Series-46 roll). Primary input for trade #30; CDX.NA.HY captured as a risk-appetite reference (§2.8 stress).

cdx_annex.name: S&P DJI CDX.NA.IG Index Annex — Composition (DISABLED: CDN blocks automation)
cdx_annex.description: Semi-annual CDX.NA.IG constituent annex (125 names + RED codes + weightings). S&P Global's CDN (Akamai bot protection) returns HTTP 403 to automated requests even with a real browser User-Agent — manual browser download only. NOT required for QL pricing of trade #30 (priced off the index-implied flat hazard curve from dtcc_index above); used only for (1) verifying ORCL/META overlap with the index and (2) sub-index sector tilt for AI-capex stress decomposition. Cadence: semi-annual, refreshed at each roll (Mar 20 / Sep 20). Current on-the-run: Series 46 (effective 2026-03-20); Series 47 rolls 2026-09-20.
